---
applyTo: "frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
---

# Frontend Development Instructions

- Use React functional components and TypeScript.
- Follow the existing component and styling conventions.
- Inspect the existing UI before introducing new layouts or components.
- Prefer reusable components for repeated UI elements.
- Keep API calls separate from presentation logic where practical.
- Use the existing API utilities and TypeScript interfaces.
- Do not introduce mock data into production functionality.
- Handle loading, error, empty, and success states.
- Ensure forms have validation and useful error messages.
- Make layouts responsive for desktop and mobile.
- Use semantic HTML and accessible form controls.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Do not change backend behavior to accommodate a frontend-only
  presentation change.
- Add comments to explain non-obvious implementation details.
